notes.title: "Fairy Biography 6: Revenge" will be launched on Steam on August 9, 2024!
notes.content:
[b]Fairy Biography 6: Revenge will be launched on Steam on August 9, 2024. [/b]

This game uses a relaxing and puzzle-solving find-the-difference game as a medium to tell you a fantasy story - about the struggle for power between different races on this continent, the baptism of blood and the abyss of desire.
There are also new characters to bring you a brand new experience!

If you are interested, you may click on the store page below to quickly purchase and play!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2937990/Fairy_Biography_6__Revenge/

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/f73ffab99bb5259cb6ac2a93d13862b4f7f476c5.png[/img]

This story takes place on a fantasy continent where various races live.
Humans, werewolves, vampires, succubi... they were not willing to live in peace in a corner, so the war started, the smoke filled the air, and the flames of the power struggle burned on the earth.

In the end, the vampire king won, but he was on the throne, but he spent his days drinking and partying.

The seeds of crisis quietly sprouted, and this continent is about to usher in an unprecedented disaster.
But perhaps, this will be an opportunity to reshuffle the cards between races; perhaps, the continent will enter a new era because of this.

And what did the people on this continent do and what price did they pay for this struggle for power and honor?

The outcome is uncertain, and everything is a variable.
All of this will be witnessed by you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/7a9931643e4c0c618eead4a1df187a2e25549ce6.png[/img]

This is a puzzle game of finding differences.
In the game, you need to find all the differences between two pictures related to the story by comparing them.
Each level has 3 differences. When all the differences are successfully circled, the next level will be unlocked. After unlocking all levels, you can get the whole beautiful CG and gradually explore the true story of the whole game.

Which race will win in the end, and what kind of adventures will they have in the story?
This is an extreme test of the player's observation and concentration. Try to experience the complete story through all levels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/8228bed586e320117efebce6178705c6398d3a4e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Original world view and story of the imaginary continent
[*] Different characters of different races
[*] A large number of rich and beautiful CGs
[*] Interesting and casual games, simple and enjoyable
[*] One-click skip
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/39090a161b2286d1147eeff6a24ac280213b57fb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/0c7bafedf393ce932bb5e9c1913a05cb4c7cbe53.jpg[/img]
The one talking to the human leader Alinda is...
The elegant and sinister diplomat from the neighboring country?

She seems to have an unclear relationship with Alinda - after all, Alinda can give everything for the interests of the human camp.

[hr][/hr]

We are a group of developers who love games and life, and we are committed to creating a game that can touch people's hearts.

Customer service: LG Meow Friend code: 1478325586;

Steam group: https://steamcommunity.com/chat/invite/kPDvtqCg

Developer homepage: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/37430609

Customer service email: lovelygames888@gmail.com

[hr][/hr]

Of course, in addition to Fairy Biography 6: Revenge, we also have many games looking forward to meeting you!

[h2]A fascinating story: Ice Cream[/h2]

A derivative of A Fascinating Story. Are you curious about the past of Zhang Wei and Zhen Tian? How did the sweet and quiet junior in the company establish a secret relationship with Zhang Wei? At that time, Zhen Tian didn't seem to be as handy as she is now...

The game will be launched on September 6, 2024. All the answers are in A fascinating story: Ice Cream.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3088520/_/

[h2]Hot And Lovely XXII[/h2]

Hot And Lovely is back with a sequel. Classic match-3-match gameplay, keep clearing levels, and have a sweet date with the girls from the magic book!
The game is expected to be launched on October 1, 2024.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3088550/Hot_And_Lovely_XXII/

[h2]Hypnosis Cards 2[/h2]

Use hypnosis cards to fight against girls and interact with them in a heart-pounding way. It's up to you to decide whether you want to be a card master or a love expert!
The launch time of the game is yet to be determined, so stay tuned.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2863310/2/

notes.title: AVG mode! ? The latest revelations from "A fascinating story"! Come and watch~
notes.content:
Hey, friends, good morning! Another beautiful day~ Meow Meow is here to wish everyone a happy day!
Our new game "A Fascinating story" (expected to be released on May 17th) is about to be launched. This is L&P Studio's [u][b]first time[/b][/u] trying to integrate it into the game[u][b]AVG[/b][/u] How to play! Compared with before, this game experience will be richer~

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2756390/A_fascinating_story/

[h3]Story introduction:[/h3]
You were supposed to be a successful person with both career and love, but you were betrayed by your company and resigned in anger! But it was completely blocked by the industry...
I was immersed in my girlfriend's gentle hometown and spent a time of revelry and wealth.
When all the savings were spent, he was ruthlessly abandoned by his girlfriend...
Another accident happened and he was involved in a robbery case and became the only witness...
[b]A wealthy and sexy fitness instructor, a female colleague who loves you, a policewoman tracking you down, a former college classmate, and an ex-girlfriend who abandoned you...[/b]
The entanglement of fate quickly heated up your relationship, and A Fascinating story began~


[h3]Game content:[/h3]
In the game, you will play the protagonist, and through action choices you will improve yourself, earn money, and finally successfully start a business, live with beautiful women, and escape from the bottom of life! There are many events waiting for you to experience in the game, and at the same time, you can also meet five women with different personalities! What kind of ending there will be depends entirely on your own choice!

[h3]Character introduction:[/h3]
⚪[b]Do Yeon[/b]——[i][u]Policewoman[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865147/fcdc87ce1a65ed36bcb40f013ff898ed21e47096.png[/img]
On their wedding night, her husband was killed in revenge. In the past three years, I have devoted all my energy to work and have been looking for the murderer. I accidentally discovered that it is related to this theft case, and you are the only breakthrough in this case! ?

⚪[b]Denise[/b]——[u][i]Luxury shop assistant[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865147/8cf7e4a62e5e6045772f4122242f852fb331e9f4.png[/img]
Dumped my ex-girlfriend. Although he is extremely money-worshiping and vain, he is beautiful, has a great figure, and has constant suitors. However, she is really the best!

⚪[b]Zhen Tian[/b]——[u][i]Former employee (colleague) of an industrial giant[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865147/8311ec3157bdc187ad60c96bd0b4ec9a860dc654.png[/img]
The descendant you brought up admired you very much and had a secret relationship with you, even if you told her that it was impossible for you.

⚪[b]Xu Zhenqian[/b]——[u][i]Coach[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865147/1efa63d94e9cc02ee86d4f889cc6bfc881586abb.png[/img]
Your fitness instructor has a great figure, but his reputation in the gym is not good! Wait, she seems to know the female police officer?

⚪[b]Wang Shijing[/b]——[u][i]Housewife[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865147/f8e42251e5f80accaee7e585922f68b3ee807c9f.png[/img]
The female classmate I once had a crush on, remembers her as a standard good girl when she was a middle school student. But they chose to get married after graduating from college... It seems that they are now at odds with each other.


[h3]Game introduction:[/h3]
[h4]Unique room menu[/h4] ——complete development gameplay, reasonable time management master~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865147/21f31fc28d1e34458d5916017945e96ee3547b37.jpg[/img]
[h4]Interesting random events[/h4]——Trigger special random events to make working and starting a business no longer boring~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865147/18646ce561d7af8f1391c9f9ff4977ff6ad8111a.jpg[/img]
[h4]Date with the character[/h4]——As your favorability continues to increase, choose the beauty you like to date~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865147/d52be96ebd6ccc4a37926886b53cc6bb99dff5b8.jpg[/img]
[h4] Choose your own gifts[/h4] - Giving gifts can increase your goodwill, and increasing your goodwill will trigger some events~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865147/751a22e37a0e5efbb5ddb3513116bed4a96d3fc2.jpg[/img]
[h4] Make money and start a business[/h4]——By grasping the financial management opportunities in the game, you can increase your income and start a business investment!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865147/a9c8a28181c381f0f0582560e8e034262d32bacd.jpg[/img]
[h4]A complete plot story[/h4] ——What is the truth behind this robbery and the murder of the policewoman’s husband?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865147/a7fd5fcd1fc115bde5337c7bd610d654c6166486.jpg[/img]
[h4] Free choice on the big map[/h4]——multiple different endings, free choice, what kind of life you want is all in your hands!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865147/3c2fcfb1ae7e4f19ffeb43faa95978bf5b074f56.jpg[/img]
[h4]Interesting mini-games[/h4]——Randomly triggered mini-games make the pursuit of the truth colorful
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865147/158b1e4bb33ae9d2eac1aa738df07062c6b23e96.jpg[/img]
[h4]Passionate memories[/h4] ——you may find unexpected surprises
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865147/c5e4a7693a9b94cc437ebc55bbde7a199d33269d.jpg[/img]

"A fascinating story" is a game that we and L&P Studio have paid great attention to recently! There will be a lottery for this game at the end of the month. I hope everyone will pay more attention and support! If you have any questions, please leave them in the comment area, and Maomao will answer them for you!

[h3]Contact us:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Development team homepage:[/b][url=store.steampowered.com] https://store.steampowered.com/curator/37430609[/url]
[*] [b]Google email:[/b][url=store.steampowered.com] lovelygames888@gmail.com[/url]
[/list]
Welcome to join our group and chat together through the development team homepage~

Don’t forget there are new games on April 19th:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2732500/Fairy_Biography5__Demon/
coming soon:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2892840/Hot_And_Lovely_Dream/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2863310/2/
